up: Retrieve all compounds associated with the document that has ChEMBL ID CHEMBL3603819. For each compound, provide: the compound's ChEMBL ID, its preferred name (pref_name), its maximum development phase (max_phase), its molecule type (molecule_type), and its canonical SMILES. The document is identified from the docs table. Use compound_records to link the document (doc_id) to compounds (molregno). Then join molecule_dictionary for compound details and compound_structures for SMILES. Include every compound that has a record in compound_records for this document, even if the SMILES is missing (in that case show NULL). Return each distinct compound only once.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
    md.chembl_id AS chembl_id,
    md.pref_name,
    md.max_phase,
    md.molecule_type,
    cs.canonical_smiles
FROM docs d
JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno
LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3603819';
